annotations.title: Search JobStreet, JobsDB & SEEK APAC Job Listings

description: Search active APAC job listings, hiring companies, and disclosed salary bands across JobStreet, JobsDB, and SEEK covering Singapore (SG), Malaysia (MY), Philippines (PH), Indonesia (ID), Hong Kong (HK), Thailand (TH), Australia (AU), and New Zealand (NZ) (`corridordata/jobstreet-jobsdb-apac-scraper`).

countries.description: APAC market portals to query in parallel.

keywords.description: Search query for role, skill, or employer name.

location.description: Optional city or sub-region filter (e.g. 'Kuala Lumpur', 'Makati', 'Central').

maxItems.description: Maximum APAC job listings to return.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Optional per-run USD spend cap forwarded to Apify Pay-Per-Event billing (`maxTotalChargeUsd`).

postedWithinDays.description: Only include listings posted within the last N days.

withSalaryOnly.description: Only return listings with publicly stated salary bands.

name: search_apac_jobs
